"""Shared completed-case selection for observation diagnostics.

Explicit selection wins; otherwise results/reference_selection.json supplies
reference_case, with the historical priority used only when no selection exists.
No empirical calibration or simulation data are changed here.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

CASE_PRIORITY=("wide_fine","wide_medium","fine","medium","coarse","wide_coarse")
NONPHYSICAL_EXPORT_CASES={"wide_movie","pilot","interrupted_wide_medium"}


def safe_name(name):
    if not isinstance(name,str) or not name or name in {".",".."} or Path(name).name!=name or "/" in name or "\\" in name:
        raise ValueError("Case must be a single results directory name")
    if name in NONPHYSICAL_EXPORT_CASES:
        raise ValueError(f"{name} is an export/pilot case, not a physical validation reference")
    return name


def completed(root,name):
    safe_name(name)
    folder=Path(root)/"results"/name
    return (folder/"statistics.json").is_file() and (folder/"probe.csv").is_file() and (folder/"probe.csv").stat().st_size>0


def select_case(root,explicit=None,available=None):
    root=Path(root)
    allowed=None if available is None else list(available)
    if explicit is not None:
        case=safe_name(explicit)
        source="explicit --case"
        details={}
    elif allowed is not None:
        # Legacy --cases explicitly restricts candidates; no outside case is injected.
        ready=[x for x in allowed if x not in NONPHYSICAL_EXPORT_CASES and completed(root,x)]
        if not ready:raise ValueError("No requested case has completed statistics and probe data")
        case=next((x for x in CASE_PRIORITY if x in ready),ready[0])
        source="explicit --cases priority"
        details={"requested_cases":allowed}
    else:
        path=root/"results/reference_selection.json"
        if path.exists():
            selection=json.loads(path.read_text())
            if not isinstance(selection,dict) or not selection.get("reference_case"):
                raise ValueError("results/reference_selection.json must contain reference_case")
            case=safe_name(selection["reference_case"])
            source="results/reference_selection.json"
            details={"selection":selection,"selection_sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
        else:
            ready=[x for x in CASE_PRIORITY if completed(root,x)]
            if not ready:raise ValueError("No historical priority case has completed statistics and probe data")
            case=ready[0]
            source="historical completed-case priority"
            details={"priority":list(CASE_PRIORITY)}
    if not completed(root,case):
        raise ValueError(f"Selected case {case} is incomplete: require results/{case}/statistics.json and probe.csv")
    if allowed is not None and case not in allowed:raise ValueError("Selected case is outside explicitly requested candidates")
    return case,{"reference_case":case,"source":source,**details}


def case_provenance(root,case):
    safe_name(case)
    folder=Path(root)/"results"/case
    files={}
    for name in ["run.cfg","metadata.json","statistics.json","probe.csv"]:
        path=folder/name
        if path.exists():files[name]={"path":f"results/{case}/{name}","bytes":path.stat().st_size,"sha256":hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    return {"case":case,"files":files}
"}

+"""Label comet-frame samples by photon arrival at the geometric Earth proxy.
+
+Reuses the independently qualified retarded/inverse mapping. It changes the
+comparison clock, never the MHD solution or native-spacecraft validation.
+"""
+from pathlib import Path
+from functools import lru_cache
+import sys
+import numpy as np
+
+ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
+sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'observations'))
+from light_travel_time_audit import arrival_time, checked_interpolate
+
+
+@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
+def geometric_positions():
+    result=[]
+    for name in ['comet','wind']:
+        a=np.genfromtxt(ROOT/'observations'/f'ephemeris_{name}.tsv',delimiter='\t',names=True,dtype=None,encoding='utf8')
+        result.append((np.asarray(a['mjd_utc'])-60980,
+                       np.column_stack([a[k] for k in ['x_au','y_au','z_au']])))
+    return result
+
+
+def observer_case(a,selection):
+    convention=selection.get('time_convention','simultaneous_geometric_UTC')
+    if convention=='simultaneous_geometric_UTC':
+        return a
+    if convention!='observer_arrival':
+        raise ValueError('Unknown selected comparison time convention: '+str(convention))
+    (tc,xc),(te,xe)=geometric_positions()
+    comet=lambda t:checked_interpolate(t,tc,xc,'Comet ephemeris')
+    earth=lambda t:checked_interpolate(t,te,xe,'Earth observer-proxy ephemeris')
+    arrival=arrival_time(a['day'],comet,earth)
+    if np.any(np.diff(arrival)<=0):
+        raise ValueError('Nonmonotonic photon-arrival mapping')
+    return {**a,'day':arrival,'emission_day':a['day'],
+            'time_convention':'observer_arrival'}
